rows.name: Find the Missing Teacher
rows.description: Investigate the initial disappearance and identify where the missing teacher was last seen.

objectives.description: Determine where the teacher disappeared from the Magaambya.
objectives.next_step: Talk to Okoro, inspect the tok-missing-teacher room, and log the teacher's last confirmed location.
objectives.wayfinding_hint: Start at the tok-missing-teacher location on campus and question nearby mentors for the latest sighting.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when identify_last_known_location records one confirmed last-known-location clue.

rows.name: Gather Campus Clues
rows.description: Question allies and inspect the academy grounds for evidence connected to the disappearance.

objectives.description: Collect enough evidence on campus to follow the mystery into Nantambu.
objectives.next_step: Question campus contacts, investigate clue sites in campus-clues, and capture one actionable lead.
objectives.wayfinding_hint: Move through campus-clues locations and record one confirmed lead tied to the missing teacher.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when collect_magaambya_clues records one actionable campus lead.

rows.name: Follow the City Leads
rows.description: Pursue the investigation beyond the academy and track the mystery through Nantambu.

objectives.description: Follow the strongest leads through the city.
objectives.next_step: Travel to Nantambu, follow the top city lead, and confirm the investigation destination.
objectives.wayfinding_hint: Travel to nantambu via the city transition point, then follow the highest-confidence clue marker.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when trace_nantambu_leads marks the Nantambu destination as discovered.

rows.name: Resolve the Threat
rows.description: Confront the underlying danger and close out the mystery threatening the Magaambya.

objectives.description: Defuse the danger tied to the missing teacher and secure the academy.
objectives.next_step: Confront tok-underlying-threat in threat-revealed and complete the resolution interaction sequence.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when stop_the_underlying_threat is flagged completed and academy safety is restored.
